div.head: Cn 1018 11
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is þæt hi willað. þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan. ælc to ðam rihte þe him to gebyrige. 7 huruþinga. godes þeowas. biscopas. 7 abbodas. munecas. 7 minicena. canonicas. 7 nunnan to rihte gebugan. 7 regollice libban. 7 dæges. 7 nihtes oft 7 gelome. clipian to criste. 7 for eal cristen folc þingian georne.

And witena gerædnes is þæt hi willað þæt ælces hades men georne gebugan, ælc to ðam rihte þe him to gebyrige; and huruþinga Godes þeowas—biscopas and abbodas, munecas and minicena, canonicas and nunnan—to rihte gebugan and regollice libban, and dæges and nihtes oft and gelome clipian to Criste, and for eal Cristen folc þingian georne.

And the decree of the councillors is that they desire that men of every rank zealously submit, each to the duty which is appropriate to him, and certainly [that] the servants of God, bishops and abbots, monks and nuns, canons and women dedicated to God, submit to their duty, and live according to their rule, and day and night, often and frequently, call upon Christ, and zealously intercede for all Christian people.

And the council’s decree is that that those of every rank shall faithfully submit to the duty most appropriate for them; and God’s servants especially—bishops and abbots, male and female monastics, canons and nuns—are to submit to their duty and live according to their rule, and often and frequently call on Christ by day and night, and fervently intercede for all Christian people.
